answers.answer: Kitewing FieldOps runs on Google Cloud in US regions (primary us-central1, backups in a second US region). EU hosting is on the 2027 roadmap and not available today.
All customer data is encrypted at rest with AES-256 by Google Cloud. Database and backup keys are managed in Cloud KMS with annual rotation. Customer-managed keys are not offered.
All traffic uses TLS 1.2 or higher (TLS 1.3 preferred) with HSTS. The mobile app pins the API certificate.

SAML 2.0 SSO and SCIM provisioning are included in the Enterprise plan. All plans support MFA (authenticator app or security key) and admins can enforce it. Passwords are hashed with a modern adaptive algorithm.

Kitewing holds a SOC 2 Type II report (Security, Availability, Confidentiality) covering Oct 2025 – Sep 2026; the 2026 renewal audit is in progress (PRJ-109). The report is shared under NDA. ISO 27001 is not held.

An independent penetration test runs annually (last: May 2026, no critical or high findings open). Automated vulnerability scanning runs weekly; critical issues are patched within 7 days, high within 30.
Databases use point-in-time recovery with daily full backups kept 35 days. Targets: RPO 15 minutes, RTO 4 hours. Disaster-recovery restore is tested twice a year.
Enterprise includes a 99.9% monthly uptime SLA with service credits. Growth and Starter target 99.9% without credits. A public status page reports incidents.
A documented incident-response plan is tested annually. Customers are notified of a confirmed personal-data breach without undue delay and within 72 hours.
Production access is limited to 4 named engineers via just-in-time elevation with MFA and full audit logging. All employees pass background checks and annual security training.
Platform logs are retained 400 days. The customer-facing audit log (Enterprise) records logins, permission changes, exports and deletions.
Subprocessors: Google Cloud (hosting, AI models), a transactional email provider and an SMS gateway. The current list is in the DPA annex; customers get 30 days' notice of changes.
Kitewing signs a standard Data Processing Addendum. Kitewing is a processor; the customer is the controller. Data-subject requests are supported through admin export and deletion tools.
Customer data is retained for the contract term. On termination customers can export for 30 days; data is then deleted within 60 days, backups age out within 35 days.

Kitewing Assist uses Google's Gemini models through Vertex AI. Customer data and prompts are not used to train models, are processed in US regions and are covered by the same DPA. Admins can disable Assist per user group.
The mobile app stores offline data encrypted on the device, supports remote sign-out by admins and never stores payment card data.
Card payments are handled by a PCI DSS Level 1 payment processor through hosted fields; Kitewing never stores or processes full card numbers.
All changes are peer-reviewed and pass automated tests and dependency scanning before deployment. Engineers complete secure-coding training annually (OWASP Top 10).
